row: Kuri K9 Massage, Content for Parents of Fur Babies

I started Kuri K9 Massage to create healthier, happier lives for fur babies AND their parents—ultimately adding to both the quality AND quantity of the pet’s life, thereby making the most of the time they have with their human parents.  
This channel provides content to animal enthusiasts covering a wide range of topics...basically, anything of interest to pet lovers everywhere, including information about Canine and Feline massage therapy, Reiki, and issues in the pet industry. There are animals available for adoption featured (and their updates and happy endings when they find their forever homes!), interviews with experts, and videos directly from Kuri K9 Massage and much, much more!
